text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-4321 - auth-service: JWT signature verification failures > 5% (1m). Routing page to oncall rotation :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Page sent to rotation: oncall-maya. Escalation policy: auth-team -> platform -> eng-sre.
Maya: Acked. I'm on it.
Sam: I see a spike in 401s in the metrics dashboard, correlated with token verify errors. URL: https://telemetry/redwood/auth/edge/errors
Jonas: I'm in, jumping onto auth. Any recent deploys?
Sam: There was a deploy of the signer microservice ~03:50 UTC (image: signer:v3.0.0) rolled to canary then traffic-shifted to prod at 04:05.
Jonas: Checking logs. Quick grep shows lots of "invalid signature" and "kid not found" in verifier logs.
Customer Ops: Received alerts from two customers complaining about 401s on API calls. They see new session failures starting ~04:06 UTC.
Maya: Can you paste a sample error log, Jonas?
Jonas: Sure, snippet from verifier stdout:
```
ERROR auth.verifier: token validation failed: signature verification failed, kid=kp_2026_04_05, available_kids=[kp_2026_03_01]
stack: auth/verifier/validate.go:87
```
Lisa: That looks like a JWKS mismatch — new signer published a key id that isn't in our JWKS cache or didn't propagate to downstream validators.
Jonas: Confirmed. The signing service started advertising a new KID but the JWKS endpoint returned only the old key for a while (caching TTLs + CDNs maybe).
Maya: Immediate mitigation options?
Sam: We can either rollback signer to previous image (v2.1.3) or force-push JWKS with the legacy key, or add a temporary fallback to accept the old KID. Rolling back is safest.
Jonas: I'll start a rollback now and also clear JWKS cache at the CDN layer.
Maya: @Customer Ops can you send a brief note to the impacted customers (incidents channel) saying we're investigating and there's an auth token validation issue? Keep it short.
Customer Ops: Sending now. Message: "We're aware of token validation errors causing 401s for some customers; engineering is actively mitigating. We will update in ~15 minutes."
pagerduty: escalation: since ack within 1m, no auto-escalation.
Jonas: Rolling back signer deployment: `kubectl set image deploy/signer signer=registry.redwood/signer:v2.1.3 -n prod`
Jonas: Also purging CDN cache for /auth/.well-known/jwks.json: `cdn-purge --path /auth/.well-known/jwks.json`
Sam: Also bump JWKS cache TTL to 10s in verifier for now (hotfix) — will deploy a small config change if rollback doesn't fully resolve.
Maya: Handing off oncall to Lisa in 10m, I'm out for a short meeting. Lisa, can you take over if this persists?
Lisa: Oncall ack, I'll monitor the rollback and metrics.
Jonas: Rollback complete, pods back to v2.1.3, verifier logs showing low error rate now.
Jonas: After purge, JWKS includes both old and new keys (for a short overlap) but signature errors dropped to baseline within ~120s.
Sam: Metrics: token verify error rate down from 6.2% -> 0.3% over 3 minutes. Latency normal.
Maya: Nice work. Severity: P0 while customers impacted. We'll keep the channel open until stable for 30m.
Customer Ops: Customers updated: "Issue mitigated, engineering rolled back a recent signer change. Monitoring for residual errors."
Jonas: Root cause notes (short): signer release v3.0.0 introduced a new KID rotation flow; JWKS propagation check skipped due to CDN cache TTLs and a missing propagation health-check.
Lisa: Immediate actions logged: 1) Rollback signer (done), 2) Purge JWKS CDN (done), 3) Shorten verifier JWKS TTL (pending prod config push).
Maya: Longer term: add preflight JWKS push & propagation check in rollout pipeline, add canary traffic check specifically for `kid` presence, and implement automated rollback if verification error rate > 1% for 2 consecutive minutes.
Jonas: I'll own the postmortem and the remediation tasks. Setting owner: Jonas. Targeting postmortem draft in 48h.
Maya: Oncall handoff to Lisa now. Lisa is primary; I'll be reachable.
Lisa: I'll keep monitoring and escalate if any regressions.
incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-4321 updated: status=mitigated, severity=P0 -> monitoring, postmortem_owner=Jonas.
Maya: Thanks team. Follow-up action items in #incidents-postmortems. :thumbsup:
